story: Sophie is sitting in the garden with her mum. They are looking at the red flowers. [emotion:QT/surprised] Sophie sees something small and shiny under a big green leaf. [gesture:stretching] Sophie picks up the leaf. There is a tiny fairy sitting there! [emotion:QT/surprised] The fairy has little wings and a small magic wand. [emotion:QT/sad] The fairy's wand is broken. Sophie and her mum find three small sticks. They help the fairy fix her wand. The fairy waves her wand. [emotion:QT/happy] Little stars and sparkles fly into the air. Sophie and her mum are smiling. [emotion:QT/happy]
